newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Asian Terminal said a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Asian Terminal said a "buy".

text.p: BPI Securities Corp recommended on Thursday a buy on port operator Asian Terminals Inc after it posted strong first semester net income ending December last year.
Analyst Spencer Yap in a research paper said earnings are expected to grow further due to higher contianer traffic spawned by a growing economy.

"The share price does not reflect this earnings potential with valuations in the mid-teens vis-a-vis fiscal year 1997 earnings ... prospects are strong given the continued rise in trade buoyed by the growth in the economy," Yap said.
